How Tesla's Cybercab factory makes one car every 10 seconds in 4K
caption:
Tesla's Cybercab factory is running at one vehicle off the line every 10 seconds, a pace most car plants don't reach in an entire minute.

The process behind it is called unboxed manufacturing. Instead of building up from a single rolling chassis the way car factories have worked for a century, Tesla assembles the car in large sub-sections separately and joins them at the end. Fewer handoffs, fewer bottlenecks, faster output. The footage here is 4K, shot directly at the production line.

At that rate, a single factory could put out thousands of Cybercabs a week.
